methods.title: Split mandatory reference reads after a combined shell timeout
methods.failure_signature: The first combined read of two required skill references exceeded its ten-second shell bound and returned no content.
trigger_preconditions: combined read timed out before content
methods.candidate_workaround: Use standalone bounded reads for mandatory instruction references when shell startup dominates a combined short timeout.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never act from a partially returned instruction file; increase only the per-read bound after decomposition.
methods.rollback: Stop task actions until every mandatory reference has been read completely.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Assign ordered hash literals before enumeration in Windows PowerShell
methods.failure_signature: The first live-verification script failed at parse time because an ordered hash literal was enumerated inline without parentheses.
methods.candidate_workaround: Assign ordered PowerShell hash literals to named variables before calling instance methods.
methods.recurrence_guard: Avoid method calls directly on ordered-hashtable literals in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure and make no repository mutation until the corrected proof passes.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Resolve inherited artifact names from the tree instead of guessing
methods.failure_signature: An inheritance inventory guessed a tooling index filename that did not exist in the v645-v4 packet.
methods.candidate_workaround: Enumerate inherited artifact paths before selecting a phase-specific filename.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use rg --files or a literal directory listing before opening optional or versioned artifacts.
methods.rollback: Stop the lookup and preserve the source packet; do not create a compatibility filename merely to hide the miss.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Parse proposal JSON when line-oriented title filters return no evidence

methods.candidate_workaround: Use structured JSON parsing for semantic ledger queries and reserve rg for discovery or literal text checks.
methods.recurrence_guard: An empty line-regex result is never evidence of semantic absence until the structured field query agrees.
methods.rollback: Withdraw the novelty conclusion and rerun from parsed records.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Fail closed when Windows Sandbox status requires elevation
methods.failure_signature: The read-only Windows optional-feature query could not return a feature state without elevation, and the Sandbox executable was absent.
trigger_preconditions: Windows Sandbox feature state is elevation-gated
methods.candidate_workaround: Treat an elevation-gated Sandbox audit as an open environment gap and stop at read-only evidence.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never elevate, enable a Windows feature, or reboot merely to satisfy a validation template.
methods.rollback: Leave the host unchanged and retain the unavailable receipt.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Reject high-overlap semantic collisions after exact-title checks pass
methods.failure_signature: Manual overlap review found that the first P08 link-purpose candidate repeated v6442-P08 and the first P09 Onsager candidate repeated v6442-P09 despite zero exact normalized-title collisions.
trigger_preconditions: token or manual review shows a shared central mechanism
methods.candidate_workaround: Use exact-title checks only as the first novelty gate, then inspect high token overlaps and compare mission, evidence, falsifier, and recovery semantics manually.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not freeze a proposal whose closest predecessor covers the same central mechanism, even when wording differs.
methods.rollback: Keep the candidate rejected, preserve its comparison evidence, and redesign before the x1 commit.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Recover a predecessor builder inspection that exceeded the output budget
methods.failure_signature: A full read of the predecessor evidence builder exceeded the available tool and context output, so the tail was truncated.
methods.candidate_workaround: Index functions first, then read only the function or bounded line range needed for the current implementation.
methods.recurrence_guard: Estimate output size before reading large generated builders and prefer function-level inspection.
methods.rollback: Discard the incomplete read as authoritative evidence and repeat only the bounded relevant inspection.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Split a parallel inspection whose per-command timeout was too short

methods.candidate_workaround: Repeat the read-only probes with bounded sixty-second command limits and preserve each result separately.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use realistic per-command limits for cold Windows repository probes while keeping user updates below sixty seconds.
methods.rollback: Terminate only the timed-out diagnostic and make no repository mutation.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Replace aggregate bounded reads that still exceeded the combined output limit
methods.failure_signature: Several individually bounded script ranges were combined into one response whose aggregate output was still truncated.
methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect one function at a time or query compact symbols and shapes programmatically.
methods.recurrence_guard: Budget aggregate output as well as each component output.
methods.rollback: Do not infer unseen content from the truncation; request only the missing narrow segment.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Introspect frozen definition symbols before assuming predecessor names

methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect frozen exported names before writing phase builders that import them.

methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Keep the x2 Method Flow append separate from the immutable x1 state path
